_comment: Each entry is your NSE trading symbol, exactly as it appears on nseindia.com. The optional bseCode is BSE's numeric scrip code for the same company — add it to enable BSE as a second fallback source (find a company's scrip code via bseindia.com's search). Entries without a bseCode still work fine, they just skip straight from NSE to the Yahoo fallback if NSE fails.
